headline: Scam.ai Launches Halo, Real-Time On-Device Deepfake Detection for Video Calls
summary: SAN FRANCISCO, August 05, 2026--Scam.ai, the company building state-of-the-art AI to detect deepfakes and AI-driven fraud, today announced the launch of Halo, a real-time, on-device deepfake detection model for video meetings, developed in close collaboration with Qualcomm.
